I detected marine heatwaves in the Bothnian Sea (61.57–62.77 °N, 20.17–21.37 °E) for summer 2009 using the Copernicus Baltic SST L4 reprocessed product (`cmems_obs-sst_bal_phy-temp_my_l4_P1D-m`, one daily NetCDF file 1982–2023), following the prescribed method exactly:

  - **2009-06-26 → 2009-07-05** (up to ~2,750 active cells on 2009-06-28)
  - **2009-08-05 → 2009-08-09** (4 cells in the far western archipelago, 54.5 °N, 9.9–10.0 °E)
